mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate higher borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 6% and PAYEMS growth accelerates (> 200k new jobs), a strong labor market boosts economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in INDPRO, indicating strengthening industrial production, signals a supply-side driven economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during periods of INDPRO growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds $400 billion, indicating strong retail sales, consumer confidence is high, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when RSAFS > $400 billion, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% and CPIAUCSL growth is below 2%, an accommodative monetary policy with low inflation boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in UNRATE below 7% without a corresponding increase in PAYEMS (> 100k new jobs) may indicate labor market distortions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of instances when both conditions are met, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in HOUST, indicating strengthening housing market, boosts economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only during early-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 45% of instances during early-cycle expansions when HOUST increases, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.
